phases.name: EOline (Edge Orientation + Line)
phases.description: Orient all 12 edges on the cube while simultaneously placing the DF (Down-Front) and DB (Down-Back) edge pieces to form a line on the bottom layer.

properties.result: All edges are oriented; cube can be solved using only R, U, L, and F2/B2 moves.

algorithms.name: EO + Line Setup
algorithms.condition: Identify bad edges (typically 2, 4, 6, or 8 bad edges) during inspection, flip them using F/B moves, and place DF/DB edges.
algorithms.algorithm: F / B (Flips edges into oriented state) + D / L / R moves for line placement

phases.name: ZZF2L (First Two Layers)
phases.description: Build the left 1x2x3 block and right 1x2x3 block. Because all edges are pre-oriented, no cube rotations are required and F/D/B moves are not needed.

sample_patterns.name: Left Block Insertion
sample_patterns.condition: Pairing and inserting corner-edge pairs into the left slots.
sample_patterns.algorithm: L U L' / L' U' L

sample_patterns.name: Right Block Insertion
sample_patterns.condition: Pairing and inserting corner-edge pairs into the right slots.
sample_patterns.algorithm: R U R' / R' U' R

phases.name: LL (Last Layer - COLL / EPLL Variants)
phases.description: Because EOline guarantees all Last Layer edges are pre-oriented, you land directly in a Yellow Cross state. Last layer is completed using COLL (42 cases) + EPLL (4 cases), or full ZBLL (472 cases).

subphases.description: Solves corner orientation and corner permutation simultaneously without disturbing top edges.

cases.name: Sune - Anti-Pure
cases.algorithm: R U R' U R U2 R'

cases.name: Sune - Diagonal
cases.algorithm: F R U R' U' F' R U R' U R U2 R'

cases.name: Anti-Sune - Pure
cases.algorithm: R U2 R' U' R U' R'

cases.name: H - Columns
cases.algorithm: R U2 R' U' R U R' U' R U' R'

cases.name: Pi - Pure
cases.algorithm: F R U R' U' R U R' U' F'

cases.name: U - Forward Bar
cases.algorithm: R2 D' R U2 R' D R U2 R

cases.name: T - Rows
cases.algorithm: r U R' U' r' F R F'

cases.name: L - Pure
cases.algorithm: F' r U R' U' r' F R

subphases.subphase_name: EPLL (Edge Permutation of Last Layer - 4 Cases)
subphases.description: After COLL solves corners, only the top edges need to be cycled.

algorithms.name: Ua Perm
algorithms.algorithm: R U' R U R U R U' R' U' R2

algorithms.name: Ub Perm
algorithms.algorithm: R2 U R U R' U' R' U' R' U R'

algorithms.name: H Perm
algorithms.algorithm: M2 U M2 U2 M2 U M2

algorithms.name: Z Perm
algorithms.algorithm: M' U M2 U M2 U M' U2 M2
